verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents Paperspace billing at per-second or per-minute granularity, or states that charges stop when a machine is stopped. Auto-shutdown only moves idle machines to a stopped state and does not describe how billing works. Community posts mention only an 'hourly rate' and a flat $9/mo Pro tier, neither of which shows sub-hour metering.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I am billed at per-second or per-minute granularity and only while my instance is actually running
